finalCanvas.explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 102 to 68 lines (33.3%) and from 7,207 to 4,982 characters (30.9%). It retains the main component boundaries, dependencies, command paths, identity relationships, and ownership responsibilities. Four peripheral trees expand parsing, edit preparation, source evidence, and runtime ownership. [M] denotes modular structure, [C] calls, [O] ownership, and [D] data dependency. Edges attach to the specific concepts being expanded; positions leave gaps between measured text bounds.

Source-grounded corrections: resolve remaps active jump source anchors, while target values pass through into the cloned view; the seed's broader wording could imply target remapping. Source-query helpers expose existing references without cloning or freezing them themselves, so their read-only contract should not be mistaken for an independent runtime immutability boundary. For patches with retainMappings, retained mappings take precedence over supplied mappings. Annotation and source-mapping edits preserve the numeric content revision while reviseDiagram issues a fresh revision identity for their new payload objects.

Details absent from the seed include WeakMap cache ownership, parser defaults and compatibility checks, multiline anchor limitations, source-binding ID derivation, evidence-range validation, edit-range precedence, and the separation between derivation ancestry and identity sources. These come only from the supplied source text. The registry, interpreter, patching helpers, and durable adapters are not supplied implementations; their internal behavior is not inferred. Flush-before-publication is shown as the supplied store comment's contract, not demonstrated persistence behavior.

|   |   |-- diagramId = service identity; revisionId = issued revision identity
|   |   `-- id + revision = local content key + numeric content revision
|   |-- buildDiagramContent: ASCII + kind + parser version -> canonical content
|   |   |-- [D] ASCII -> SHA-256; version pins structure and node derivation
|   |   |-- tree -> strict interpreter -> stored nodes, links, roots, fold ranges
|   |   `-- diagram -> ASCII + parser marker; nodes derived on demand
|   |-- diagramContentNodes: common access to tree, graph, and legacy nodes
|   |   `-- [D] Content revision + ASCII hash + local anchor -> content node ID
|   `-- validateDiagram: rebuild canonical content with its stored parser version
|       |-- Check identities, source hash, mappings, evidence, and annotations
|       `-- <= 20000 printable ASCII characters; blank rectangle exception
|-- [M] Revision commands and private assembly
|   |-- createDiagram / reviseDiagram / deriveDiagram depend on revision editor
|   |-- [C] create: prepareCreate -> constructDiagram -> issueDiagramRevision
|   |-- [C] revise: context binding -> base -> prepareEdit
|   |   |-- source-mappings: expected hash gate; clone mappings and evidence

|   |-- [C] derive: prepare replacement; claim identities from supplied revisions
|   |   `-- Sources must share base.diagramId; each claim selects one output node
|   `-- [O] issueDiagramRevision assembles and deep-freezes the record
|       |-- Record = id + diagramId + diagram + nodeRefs + optional parentId
|       |-- With base: parentId = base.id; then validate the issued payload
|       `-- Domain commands return revisions; retention/publication is explicit
|-- [D] Logical node continuity
|   |-- nodeRefs: revision-scoped content node ID -> persistent logical identity
|   |-- Identity priority: explicit derivation -> base correspondence -> fresh UUID
|   |-- correspondingNodes requires identical ASCII and structure kind
|   |   `-- Match a unique node by line, start/end columns, and label
|   |-- Editor claims: base logical ref -> integer output line with exactly one node
|   |   `-- Reject conflicting inferred matches and duplicate output identities
|   `-- [C] resolve: context + local diagram ID -> revision -> cloned DiagramView
|       |-- Remap node, parent, child, and active jump SOURCE anchors to logical IDs
|       `-- Jump targets pass through; canonical payload is not returned
|-- [M] Source evidence and generated edits
|   |-- sourceContext = contentHash + mappings + evidence + optional binding
|   |   |-- [D] entityId -> evidence; sourceRangeIndex -> range; optional ID agrees
|   |   `-- Content hash must match ASCII; binding identifies corpus and profile
|   |-- diagramSource / queryDiagramSourceContext expose joined source queries
|   |   `-- All entries, rectangular selection, or entity/label/path/symbol search
|   `-- [C] submitDiagramEdit validates and dispatches a generated candidate
|       |-- Check base revision and local diagram ID; reject new replacementRanges
|       |-- Context priority: base -> request context -> constructed placeholder
|       |-- Clean candidate supplies correspondence; context supplies binding/evidence
|       |-- Base + edit ranges -> scopedReplacements -> reviseDiagram(patches)
|       |   |-- Preserve kind; remove inside mappings; shift outside mapping lines
|       |   `-- Select candidate mappings in output ranges; return replacement ranges
|       |-- Requested base without ranges -> reviseDiagram(replace)
|       `-- Otherwise create at numeric revision 0
|           `-- Existing edits request retention when sourceMappings is absent
`-- [M] Runtime retention and context bindings
    |-- Store facade: get / list / import / retain plus stored command wrappers
    |   |-- Depends on domain commands and internal revision registry
    |   `-- [C] Stored command -> domain command -> retainDiagramRevision

    |-- Editor accepts external context -> local diagram -> revision bindings

        |-- Any difference -> MERGE_REQUIRED; no automatic three-way merge

Content interpretation and derived-node lifetime
|-- [D] Parser selection in buildDiagramContent
|   |-- New tree defaults to ascii-tree-2; ascii-tree-1 remains accepted
|   |-- New diagram defaults to ascii-graph-1
|   |-- Unversioned stored diagram rebuilds as legacy-diagram
|   `-- Reject parser versions incompatible with the requested kind
|-- [C] parseAsciiTree -> shared interpreter
|   |-- Tree dialect; tree/wire tolerance 0; separate continuations; no repairs
|   |-- Walk each parent chain to accumulate descendant line numbers
|   `-- buildDiagramContent assigns node IDs from revision + hash + line
|       `-- Fold interval: line after node through line before next peer, or EOF
|-- [C] diagramContentNodes dispatches by structure
|   |-- tree: return stored nodes via Object.values
|   |-- ascii-graph-1: private graphNodes calls parseAsciiGraph
|   |   |-- Local anchor uses first text span line and column
|   |   `-- Preserve every text span in lines[] for multiline boxes
|   `-- legacy: private legacyNodes calls mixed interpreter, no repairs
|       `-- Preserve legacy interpreter IDs scoped by content revision and hash
|-- [O] Derived diagram nodes: deepFreeze -> WeakMap cache by content object
|   `-- Cache hits reuse the array; tree branch bypasses this cache
|-- Geometry: line/startColumn/endColumn anchor only the first text line
|   `-- lines[] supplies multiline spans; absent on older single-line nodes
`-- [C] visibleContentLines excludes stored fold intervals for collapsed trees
    |-- Unknown tree node ID -> STALE_CONTENT_NODE
    `-- Non-tree content returns all line numbers

Edit preparation and continuity decisions
|-- [C] source-mappings edit
|   |-- expectedContentHash must equal before.content.asciiSha256
|   |-- Clone mappings/evidence; clone binding only when supplied
|   `-- Preserve content and numeric revision; validate the new payload

|   |-- Explicit correspondence refines returned nodeIds
|   |   `-- Rebase old highlights with the refined map
|   |-- patches + retainMappings -> retainSourceMappings with lineAfter
|   `-- Supplied mappings installed only when that retention branch is inactive
|       `-- Build sourceContext using prior binding and evidence
|-- [C] replace -> constructDiagram with before.revision + 1
|   |-- Infer exact correspondence, then validate explicit claims
|   |-- Rebase prior jumps/highlights when present
|   `-- Optional retention replaces constructed sourceContext.mappings
|-- [C] jumps / highlights preserve content and numeric revision
|   `-- reviseDiagram still issues a fresh revision ID for the new payload object
|-- [D] correspondingNodes returns no inferred matches if ASCII or kind changed
|   `-- Unchanged ASCII still requires unique geometry + label matching
|-- [D] deriveDiagram identity claims
|   |-- Allowed refs are the union of supplied source revisions' nodeRefs
|   |-- Base refs also pass through editor correspondence checks
|   `-- Every claim must select one output node; no duplicate target nodes
`-- [O] Parent ancestry and logical continuity are separate
    `-- Derived parentId is base.id even when refs come from other source revisions

Source joins and scoped generated edits
|-- [M] validateDiagram guards sourceContext
|   |-- contentHash equals ASCII SHA-256; mappings is an array; evidence exists
|   |-- Binding: nonempty sourceId <= 200 chars; nonempty repositoryIdentity
|   |   |-- Corpus root must be absolute POSIX or drive-letter path
|   |   `-- source-code pairs with git-worktree; document with filesystem-documents

|-- [D] sourceBindingFromLocation
|   |-- Default corpus: git-worktree at checkoutRoot; optional gitRevision
|   `-- sourceId = source- + first 24 hex characters of hash(kind + ':' + root)
|-- [M] queryDiagramSourceContext
|   |-- Join mapping -> entity -> range, with the optional binding

|   `-- Returns existing context/mapping references; no clone or freeze here
`-- [C] submitDiagramEdit with a base and edit ranges
    |-- Nonempty editRanges takes precedence over singular editRange
    |-- validateGeneratedDiagramEdit cleans candidate before scopedReplacements
    |-- Clean nodeCorrespondence overrides caller entries with the same key

    `-- reviseDiagram(patches) receives retainMappings = !request.sourceMappings

Revision ownership and consumer views
|-- [O] issueDiagramRevision owns assembly
|   |-- Reverse old -> new node map to look up base identities
|   |-- Deep-freeze record and nested payload; validateDiagram before return
|   `-- Fresh logical UUID only when explicit/base identity is unavailable
|-- [C] retainDiagramRevision

|   |   `-- Every ref must be a nonempty string; all must be unique
|   |-- Delegate registration to internal revision registry

|-- [M] Runtime facade exposes ancestry summaries and stored commands
|   |-- list freezes each {id, diagramId, parentId} and the result array
|   `-- Durable flush-before-binding rule is a comment contract here
|-- [C] Editor's private revision lookup

    |-- Copy node records; translate id, parentId, childIds through nodeRefs
    |-- Include active jumps; strip source revisionId and contentHash
